In the two settled rollouts (1 and 3), all content checks C1–C8 and provenance check P1 passed with both PF1 and PF2 cited in justification_fact_ids, so there is no encoding mismatch or telepathy problem. The failure mode in rollouts 0 and 2 is structural: A1 repeatedly asked whether additional reviewer areas (custodial, security, administration) needed to submit findings before settling, and since neither A2 nor A3 could confirm whether those areas were required, A1 refused to issue a settle action and instead looped on the same workflow-completeness question until the turn cap was reached. The settle-eligibility condition is effectively gated on A1's confidence that all reviewers have spoken, but the shared context does not establish that A2 and A3 are the only required reviewers, causing A1 to stall indefinitely in roughly half of rollouts.
